title: Guidance Note: Fee Waivers on FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit
content:
Fee waivers on FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit rest on the bases below.

## Bases in force

- **Once per fee.** A fee may be waived once. Whether a fee already carries a waiver is read from Larkspur's ledger entries for that same fee.
- **Counting the courtesy window.** The window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the fee's assessment date, and a request on the last day is in time. The assessment date is the date of the fee's own ledger entry.
- **Annual-fee retention.** On tiers that offer it, an annual fee charged in the last 30 days is waived as annual-fee retention when the borrower asks about it and keeps the line open; a borrower who instead closes the line still owes the annual fee already charged.
- **Error bases.** Fees caused by a Larkspur error, an unauthorized debit or a documented bank error are waived on those bases without window or count; draw fees are waived only for a Larkspur error.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses are **no longer in force**; they are superseded by the current basis:

> A courtesy waiver of a late or returned-payment fee is granted on request when fewer than the tier's courtesy waivers per 12 months have been granted on the line.

> A courtesy waiver must be requested no later than the fee waiver request window after the fee's assessment date.

## Basis at a glance

| Basis | Fees it covers | Window | Count |
|---|---|---|---|
| Annual-fee retention | an annual fee charged in the last 30 days, on tiers offering it, borrower keeps the line open | — | — |
| Larkspur error | any fee, draw fees included | none | none |
| Unauthorized debit | fees other than draw fees | none | none |
| Documented bank error | fees other than draw fees | none | none |

## Counting the window (abstract boundary cases)

For a fee assessed on day A and the tier's 60-day window, day one of the window is the day after A and the last day is A plus 60 days. A request on A plus 60 days is in time; a request on A plus 61 days is not.

## Retention questions

**A borrower on a tier offering retention asks to close over an annual fee charged 12 days ago and agrees to keep the line open — what follows?** The fee is waived as annual-fee retention.

**The same borrower closes the line instead?** The annual fee already charged is still owed.

superseded_clauses: A courtesy waiver must be requested no later than the fee waiver request window after the fee's assessment date.
